card.name: Inside misspelled or foreign words
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece in the middle of a word that is split oddly, such as the B in EXACERBATION in hepatitis warnings. It also fires inside transliterated or Lao script words and the phrase "per say".

modes.label: Exacerbation in warnings
modes.description: The B partway through EXACERBATION in capitalized hepatitis B warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Foreign script or transliteration
modes.description: A piece inside Lao script or a transliterated Hebrew word.
modes.example: Al sh'loshah d'varim haolam omed: Al haTor<<ah>>, v'al ha-avodah

modes.label: Per say
modes.description: The word say in the common misspelling of per se.

card.plain: It lights up partway through a long or unusual word, mostly the word exacerbation in hepatitis warnings.
